checks: The cohomological coefficient-class cost uses n^(v+2sum g+b1), with actual O(t) SNC combinatorics and no determinant-of-intersection loss. The scalar class, not just its geometric Brauer image, is retained.

Qualitative rank-M^2 anchors suffice for fixed ordinary full orders and bimodules. No bounded-degree etale splitter or periodic anchor is assumed. All quantitative bundles are full pullbacks on the original comparable strong-cycle model.
Full-source factorization gives the Frobenius order comparison with pC; shifting the opposite bimodule by -pC places both pairings in the stated orders and gives conductor p+1.

For one fixed nonempty rank-r coefficient class, determinant ratios of twisted unit objects are ordinary rank-one Fq unit systems. The common anchor determinant cancels in their ratio, so one initial character controls all phases without an anchor Frobenius datum.

Every full ordinary Hom module has nonnegative component degrees summing to O_B(tr), so the multidegree lists cost exp(O_B(f t log(r+1))). Negative definiteness makes punctured line plus degrees a geometric line. The final precision retains only realized canonical determinant lists, ensuring actual generation of L_a.
The fixed reference orders/bimodules have bounded rank in B. Their line-kernel quotient complexes involve generated fixed determinants of degree O_B(t). Tensor words have bounded width and length.

Top-top line terms have O_B(r^2) multiplicity but O_B(t) cohomology; mixed determinant terms have O_B(r) multiplicity and O_B(tr) cohomology; bottom-bottom terms have bounded multiplicity and O_B(tr) cohomology. No O(tr^3) or t^2 term is hidden.

A single global algebra action, its associativity, balanced correspondence maps and paired relations use a fixed number of adjacent-object Hom complexes per phase. Intermediate composition indices affect coefficients/monomial count, not additional free object variables.

Fixed finite Cech contractions and bounded internal widths give actual cycles and boundary witnesses over every coefficient algebra; equations have degree bounded in R,B,p and only one p-step per adjacent phase, with no p^f equation or varying-cohomology basis strata.

The generated-source/fixed-determinant comparison uses canonical full Hom targets, scalar Hartogs and adjugates. P-linearity extends from U because the Cartier equation remains regular. It does not require a coefficient-flat root-stack hull.

The component prefactor and all determinant/scalar enumeration costs are included and bounded by q^(A_R,B t r^2). The gcd(r,q-1) remark follows from the determinant of a matrix multiplier and is ordinary-projective only.
